summary.result: It is also shown that the maximum ultimate load occurs at the full ranging distributed load, however, the minimum ultimate loads of the radial and vortical load cases are obtained by 2.336 tf/ $m^2$ , 2.256 tf/ $m^2$ , respectively, when the partially distributed load is applied at the 40% range of full arch span.
summary.background: For this purpose, the vertical, the radial, and the anti-symmetric load cases are considered, and the ratio of loading range and arch span is increased from 20% to 100%.
summary.method: It is noted that the ultimate load carrying capacities of parabolic arches are 6.929 tf/ $m^2$ for the radial load case, and 8.057 tf/ $m^2$ for the vertical load case.
